summary: Provides a framework for loop-free convergence. It explains the causes and consequences of micro-loops, which are transient forwarding loops among routers that occur while the network recomputes routes, and helps readers decide whether they matter. It is informational.

eli5.summary: After a road closes, drivers get new directions at different times and may briefly drive in circles. This document explains why those short loops happen with routers and how to think about avoiding them.

questions: what is a micro-loop in routing
how to prevent transient loops during convergence
